body:
Additional cases from my project (rdeforest/voxel-mvp), found with Claude Code and verified
on 4.6-stable via `String.to_float()` and `str_to_var()`:

| input                   | expected (correctly rounded) | Godot                   | kind          |
|-------------------------|------------------------------|-------------------------|---------------|
| 1.8143934130161599      | 1.8143934130161599           | 1.8143934130161601      | 1 ulp off     |
| 1.5e-300                | 1.5000000000000001e-300      | 1.4999999999999998e-300 | 1 ulp off     |
| 1.2345678901234567e-292 | 1.2345678901234567e-292      | 1.2345678901234569e-292 | 1 ulp off     |
| 1.2345678901234567e-293 | 1.2345678901234567e-293      | 0                       | reads as 0    |
| 2.2250738585072014e-308 | 2.2250738585072014e-308      | 0                       | reads as 0    |
| 4.9e-324                | 4.9406564584124654e-324      | 0                       | reads as 0    |
| 1e-309                  | 1.0000000000000019e-309      | 0                       | reads as 0    |
| 00000000000000000001.5  | 1.5                          | 0                       | leading zeros |

The reads-as-0 rows are a separate mechanism from the 18-digit cap: when the exponent minus
the number of fractional digits is -309 or lower, the power-of-ten scale factor overflows to
+inf and `fraction / inf` returns 0. That covers every subnormal and 17-digit values below ~1e-292.

PR #123839 addresses the leading-zeros row, but as far as I can tell not the others.

Thank you for working on this! :)
